# package timestamp

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-canopen/timestamp"
```

Package timestamp implements the CANopen TIME object (CiA 301 7.2.6) and the TIME\_OF\_DAY and TIME\_DIFFERENCE data types (CiA 301 7.1.6.5).

A [TimeOfDay](#type-timeofday) is milliseconds after midnight (28 bits) and days since 1984-01-01, encoded in 6 bytes; a [TimeDifference](#type-timedifference) has the same layout for a duration. [FromTime](#func-fromtime) and [TimeOfDay.Time](#func-timeofday-time) convert to and from time.Time (in UTC: CiA 301 does not define a time zone, and CANopen networks commonly use UTC).

A [Producer](#type-producer) sends TIME messages on the COB-ID TIME (0x1012; with a dictionary only while bit 30 "produce" is set), on request or every period. A [Consumer](#type-consumer) receives them (with a dictionary only while bit 31 "consume" is set) and reports the time to a handler.

Long-running services have Start, which subscribes before it returns, and Close, which stops them and waits for their goroutine. Callbacks run on the service's goroutine and must not block for long.

## Constants

```go
const MaxTimeDifference = 0xFFFF*day + day - time.Millisecond
```

MaxTimeDifference is the longest TIME\_DIFFERENCE: 65535 days and 86 399 999 ms.

```go
const Size = 6
```

Size is the encoded size of TIME\_OF\_DAY and TIME\_DIFFERENCE.

## Variables

```go
var Epoch = time.Date(1984, time.January, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
```

Epoch is day 0 of TIME\_OF\_DAY: 1984-01-01 00:00 UTC.

```go
var ErrNotProducer = errors.New("timestamp: not a TIME producer (0x1012 bit 30 clear)")
```

ErrNotProducer reports a TIME message the node may not send: bit 30 (produce) of the COB-ID TIME (0x1012) is clear.

```go
var Latest = TimeOfDay{Ms: msPerDay - 1, Days: 0xFFFF}.Time()
```

Latest is the last instant TIME\_OF\_DAY can represent (day 65535, 2163-06-05, at 23:59:59.999 UTC).

### type Option

```go
type Option func(*config)
```

Option configures a [Producer](#type-producer) or a [Consumer](#type-consumer). Each option names the services it applies to; the others ignore it.

#### func WithCOBID

```go
func WithCOBID(cob canopen.COBID) Option
```

WithCOBID sets the COB-ID TIME (both services; default 0x100, produced and consumed). Flag bits are ignored without a dictionary.

#### func WithClock

```go
func WithClock(clock func() time.Time) Option
```

WithClock sets the time source of a [Producer](#type-producer)'s periodic messages (default time.Now).

#### func WithDictionary

```go
func WithDictionary(d *od.Dictionary) Option
```

WithDictionary takes the COB-ID TIME from 0x1012 (which must exist) and follows its changes: a [Producer](#type-producer) sends only while bit 30 (produce) is set, a [Consumer](#type-consumer) delivers only while bit 31 (consume) is set. The write hook it installs refuses a new CAN-ID while bit 30 or 31 is set, with [canopen.AbortInvalidValue](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-canopen#AbortInvalidValue).

#### func WithHandler

```go
func WithHandler(h func(Event)) Option
```

WithHandler calls h for every TIME message a [Consumer](#type-consumer) receives, on its goroutine; h must not block for long.

#### func WithLogger

```go
func WithLogger(l *slog.Logger) Option
```

WithLogger logs service events to l (both services). The default logs nothing.

#### func WithPeriod

```go
func WithPeriod(d time.Duration) Option
```

WithPeriod makes a started [Producer](#type-producer) send the clock's time every period (default 0: only on [Producer.Send](#func-producer-send)).

### type TimeOfDay

```go
type TimeOfDay struct {
	Ms   uint32
	Days uint16
}
```

TimeOfDay is the TIME\_OF\_DAY data type: milliseconds after midnight (28 bits, 0..86 399 999) and days since Epoch.

#### func FromTime

```go
func FromTime(t time.Time) (TimeOfDay, error)
```

FromTime converts a time to TIME\_OF\_DAY in UTC, truncated to the millisecond. Times before Epoch or after Latest are an error.

#### func ParseFrame

```go
func ParseFrame(f *canbus.Frame) (TimeOfDay, error)
```

ParseFrame decodes a TIME frame: a classical data frame (not remote, not CAN FD) with a 6-byte TIME\_OF\_DAY.

#### func ParseTimeOfDay

```go
func ParseTimeOfDay(b []byte) (TimeOfDay, error)
```

ParseTimeOfDay decodes a 6-byte TIME\_OF\_DAY. The 4 reserved bits are ignored; a millisecond count of a day or more is an [canopen.ErrDataType](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-canopen#ErrDataType) error.

#### func (TimeOfDay) Bytes

```go
func (t TimeOfDay) Bytes() [Size]byte
```

Bytes returns the 6-byte encoding: milliseconds (UNSIGNED28 in 4 bytes, little-endian, upper 4 bits 0) and days (UNSIGNED16, little-endian).

#### func (TimeOfDay) String

```go
func (t TimeOfDay) String() string
```

String formats the time as RFC 3339 with milliseconds.

```go
func (t TimeOfDay) Time() time.Time
```

func (t TimeOfDay) Valid() bool
